title: Caesar Cipher Encryption and Decryption using Security Key
question: Write a C Program to perform Caesar cipher encryption and decryption algorithm by taking security key.
whereToExecute: Linux terminal (Ubuntu / WSL2 / VM) or any standard C environment.
sampleOutput:
Enter a message: Hello world
Enter the security key (shift value): 3
Encrypted Message: Khoor zruog
Decrypted Message: Hello world
note: The Caesar cipher substitutes each letter by shifting it k positions forward (encryption) and k positions backward (decryption) modulo 26, preserving case and non-alphabetic characters.
result: The C program to perform Caesar cipher encryption and decryption algorithm by taking security key was successfully executed, and the output was verified.

title: Polyalphabetic (Vigenère) Cipher Encryption and Decryption
question: Write a C Program to implement Polyalphabetic (Vigenere) cipher encryption-decryption which uses two or more cipher alphabets to encrypt the data.
whereToExecute: Linux terminal (Ubuntu / WSL2 / VM) or any standard C environment.
sampleOutput:
Enter plaintext (UPPERCASE): HELLO WORLD
Enter key (UPPERCASE): KEY

Encrypted Text: RIJVS UYVJN
Decrypted Text: HELLO WORLD
note: The Vigenère cipher uses a repeating key word where each letter shifts the corresponding plaintext letter by its alphabetical position. This flattens letter frequency and defeats simple monoalphabetic frequency analysis.
result: The C program to implement Polyalphabetic (Vigenere) cipher encryption-decryption was successfully executed, and the output was verified.

title: Transposition (Columnar Permutation) Cipher Encryption and Decryption
question: Write a C Program to implement Transposition cipher which is a simple data encryption scheme in which plaintext characters are shifted in some regular pattern to form cipher text.
whereToExecute: Linux terminal (Ubuntu / WSL2 / VM) or any standard C environment.
sampleOutput:
Enter the plaintext: welcome to bmsit
Enter the key (number of columns): 4

Ciphertext: wotmemosle ic bt

Enter the ciphertext to decrypt: wotmemosle ic bt

Decrypted Plaintext: welcome to bmsit
note: In this transposition cipher, plaintext characters are written row-by-row into a grid of 'key' columns, and ciphertext is generated by reading out the columns sequentially. Decryption reconstructs the grid column-by-column taking uneven row lengths into account.
result: The C program to implement Transposition cipher was executed successfully, and both encryption and decryption outputs were verified.
